[from.GetName]正在遭受攻击。

一大群虚空虫正在殖民地轨道上，用寄生囊肿进行轰炸。

每个囊肿都包含一个剧毒孢子，对我们的殖民者以及所有生命都极其致命。一旦被摄入，它会迅速发育成为一只若虫，并会暴力地从宿主体内破茧而出，彻底摧毁宿主。这些若虫体内有一个压缩气体囊，使它们能够上升到高层大气，在那里它们会本能地将自己推进到预定的目的地。

生物分析表明，每窝虚空虫都拥有有限数量的囊肿，它们很可能在囊肿耗尽后离开。但在那之前，我们会遭受严重的人口损失。

texts.en:
[from.GetName] is under attack.

A large group of Voidworms is in orbit of the colony, bombarding it with parasitic cysts.

Each cyst contains a toxic spore that is extremely deadly not only to our colonists, but all life. Once ingested, it rapidly gestates into a nymph that will emerge violently and completely destroy its host. These nymphs contain a bladder of compressed gases that allows them to ascend the upper atmosphere, where they instinctively propel themselves to a predetermined destination.

Biological analysis indicates that each clutch of Voidworms has a limited supply of these cysts to distribute, and it is likely they will depart once all are depleted. Until then, we are suffering significant population loss.

texts.en:
[from.GetName] is under attack.

A large group of Voidworms is in orbit of the colony, bombarding it with parasitic cysts.

Each cyst contains a toxic spore that is extremely deadly to all native fauna. Once ingested, it rapidly gestates into a nymph that will emerge violently and completely destroy its host. The nymphs, which normally feed on asteroids for their precious metals, opportunistically hunt and feed upon our vulnerable [this.GetColonistPlural].  Each hatchling contains a bladder of compressed gases that allows them to ascend to the upper atmosphere, where they instinctively propel themselves to a predetermined destination.

Biological analysis indicates that each clutch of Voidworms has a limited supply of these cysts to distribute, and it is likely they will depart once all are depleted. Until then, we are suffering significant population loss.

summary.text:
# 星际寄生虫 / Galactic Parasites

- 分类 Category：银河轶事 C8 stories · 来源 Sources：events/grand_archive_events.txt · DLC：Grand Archive · 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-13

## 如何开始 How it starts

隐藏事件 grand_archive.2190（events/grand_archive_events.txt:1232-1266）挂在行星被轨道轰炸时：敌对的虚空虫国家使用“虚空虫入侵”轰炸姿态（voidworm_invasion / voidworm_invasion_crisis），将在轨的虚空虫泰坦标为“正在轰炸”，并通知行星所有者 2195。每国只会收到一次（bombarded_by_voidworms_event）。
Hidden 2190 runs when hostile Voidworms bombard a planet with the invasion stance; the owner gets 2195 once.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

2195 “星际寄生虫”：一群虚空虫在殖民地轨道上投下寄生囊孢；唯一选项（灭绝者另有措辞）。正文对机械/岩石物种用另一版本。
2195: parasitic cysts on the colony; single option, other wording for homicidal empires; machine and lithoid species get another text.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

- 无后续。 No follow-up.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

- 机械、机械单位与岩石物种有不同正文（desc.rocks）。 Mechanical/machine/lithoid species get a variant text.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

- 已核对 Checked：2190 / 2195 的触发、标记与正文条件；紧接的 2200 为每次轰炸的隐藏结算（杀死人口）。 Checked 2190/2195; 2200 is the hidden per-bombardment pop kill.
